title: Section 358 BNSS — Power to proceed against other persons appearing to be guilty of offence

content.heading: Power to proceed against other persons appearing to be guilty of offence
content.text: Where, in the course of any inquiry into, or trial of, an offence, it appears from the evidence that any person not being the accused has committed any offence for which such person could be tried together with the accused, the Court may proceed against such person as enacted. This is the successor of CrPC 319.
